text: A tablespoon of honey or of sugar: which adds more calories?
Gram for gram, honey is lower.
It's partly water: three hundred four calories per hundred grams, sugar three eighty-seven.
But spoons measure volume. Thick honey fills every gap; sugar crystals trap air.
A tablespoon of honey weighs twenty-one grams; sugar, about twelve and a half.
So per spoon: honey about sixty-four calories, sugar forty-eight. Log the spoon you use.
